title: Dynamics 365 ERP apps plugin for Copilot Cowork: work with finance and operations data in Cowork
summary: The briefing passes: its licensing, billing, prerequisites and administrative controls are supported by Microsoft documentation. The spending-policy API exists despite the automatic pre-check warning, and the briefing reports the conflicting Microsoft instructions about allowing the Cowork client.
